_about: Shared kit parts on the Sunfish (Tools/boatkit/bk_parts.py), placed by build_fleet.py's place_kit. Body frame metres (+y starboard); on: deck, sole (the cockpit well's floor) or z; mirror: also at -y; yaw degrees about Z; flip: turned over (the kit's blocks are built hanging from their head: flip stands one on deck); socket: [the model's socket, the part's socket it sits at]. Replaces the hand-built halyard cleat and mainsheet block (Boats 11). Sunfish deck gear (docs/part-detail-loop/sunfish.md): the mainsheet's ratchet block stands on an eye on the deck forward of the cockpit and aft of the daggerboard trunk, as the class rigs it (it had been a 29 mm block on the after deck, where the Sunfish has none).
